results.reason: The English attributes remove.packages() to base R and the Spanish substituted a different package name, which the English does not claim.
The example strings are R colour names, which R does not accept in Spanish; the translated identifier vector_de_colores was left unchanged.
The ?options documentation describes scipen as a width penalty relative to scientific notation, not an absolute digit count of the number.
results.old: se preferirá la notación fija a menos que tenga más dígitos que 'scipen'.
results.new: se preferirá la notación fija a menos que sea más de 'scipen' dígitos más ancha.
